description: This file defines the 'LimitOption' interface, which represents pagination options for search results within the Eclipse Ditto project's 'thingsearch' module. It specifies methods to retrieve offset and count values and a string representation of the limit configuration.

classes.name: LimitOption
classes.description: An interface for specifying pagination settings in search results, with methods to get offset, count, and a string representation.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset (starting position) for pagination.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of results to return.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation in the format 'limit(offset,count)'.
